decision.title: The CLI bugs the book found (packet )
decision.summary: The CLI raises FODC0002 for every collection, names the library module an error comes from, undeclares predeclared prefixes for QNames in instances, and sends fn:trace and fn:message to standard error.

body.p: , after , , , , . The four findings of , each fixed at its root with an end-to-end CLI test, and the book's text and outputs in the same commits.

item.p: Collections: the program's resolver answers COLLECTION and URI_COLLECTION with NONE, so fn:collection and fn:uri-collection raise FODC0002 for any URI. It used to read a file a relative URI named and hand back BYTES, a form a collection does not allow (SXML_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, exit 4). The CLI still has no collections; one (a directory, a list) would be a new option.

Errors in library modules: sxml xquery reports an error before releasing the query, so a dynamic or type error names the module it was raised in (sxml_query_failure.has_live_location), as static errors did (). The evaluator already put the module's URI in the location; it borrows from the compiled unit.

QNames in instances (XSD 1.1 Part 1, 3.3.4.1 cvc-elt.4.1; Part 2, 3.3.18): the validator's cast bindings (sxml_schema_validator_get_cast_bindings) end with XPath's predeclared prefixes but xml bound to no namespace, which undeclares them for src/cast_lexical.c's fallback, as does for XSLT. A default value (attribute or element) is read with the namespace context of the schema document that gives it (sxml_schema_value_request.namespace_context), where its {value} is resolved; saxon-Complex complex004.v2 depends on it. XQuery's validate lax { <a xsi:type='xs:integer'/> } without xmlns:xs is now XQDY0027 (QT4 validateexpr-34, xsd-validator-034).

Trace output: the query commands give their processor sxml_stream_trace_sink over standard error (the public hook existed; no header change); sxml transform keeps its xsl:message lines and passes fn:trace and fn:message to the same sink.
Also: the --context-item document (and the input of transform and serialize) has its file URI as document URI and base URI.

Left: XTTE errors of a validation in XSLT (xsl:copy-of validation=, type=) have no line: src/function_library_schema.c raises them with the schema error's location (line 0 for a constructed node), and the evaluator then finds no source span on the internal call the XSLT lowering makes; the fix is in the lowering's spans (src/xslt_lower*.c), not cheap here. Also still open from : the content after a cvc-complex-type.2.4 rejection is not assessed, and xsi:schemaLocation is not followed by the CLI.

Counts (release drivers): XSD11 41,486 passed, unchanged; XQ40 45,996 to 46,013 (xsd-validator-034 from this packet, the rest from 2.24's 2ec77a1 in the after build); XT40 12,191 passed, 327 failed (: 12,187, 331).
